subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB184
title: Requires the State Court Administrator to study civil procedure and submit findings to the interim committees of the Legislative Assembly related to the judiciary not later than September 15, 2026.
headline: SB 184 did not pass

claims.text: SB 184 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 184 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
